​
ModuSprite
is a lightweight and flexible sprite generation tool designed specifically for top-down RPGs.
With ModuSprite, you can generate and combine layered visual parts — such as eyes, hairstyles, clothing, and accessories — using customizable attributes like sex, skin tone, and body type. The system supports batch generation, making it ideal for developers who need to quickly create modular characters in an organized way.
The tool supports the following sprite sizes:
16x Scale (Each frame: 32×32 px)
24x Scale (Each frame: 48×48 px)
32x Scale (Each frame: 64×64 px)
48x Scale (Each frame: 96×96 px)
24x32 (Each frame size for RPG Maker 2000/2003)
32x48 (Each frame size for RPG Maker XP)
Great for solo developers, pixel artists, and larger teams alike!
But, the software does not come with pre-made assets!
Instead, ModuSprite allows you to
generate only the blank pieces you need
,  using a flexible folder structure and a consistent naming system. This  new approach significantly reduces file size and helps you focus  directly on the parts you want to customize—without digging through a  massive set of unused files.
Each generated template serves as a clean base for your own edits.  You don’t have to redraw everything from scratch—just modify or build on  what fits your style. This gives you full creative control, while also  making the editing process faster and more organized.
Whether you're designing a small indie prototype or managing a  growing RPG character set, ModuSprite offers a modular, scalable way to keep your visual assets clean, customizable, and production-ready.
